**Legal compliance cannot be determined from this evidence alone.**

No tree-cover loss event of 0.5 ha or more was detected on the property between 2021 and 2025. The data did record 0.4 ha of loss in smaller patches in 2021, and smaller or narrow changes may be missed.

The evidence also records tree-cover loss before the 2020 baseline, including 67.7 ha in 2020. It does not establish whether any loss was lawful or whether the property meets applicable forest regulations. A legal assessment would require the relevant jurisdiction’s rules and supporting documentation.
